question: On compact interiors of the closed-FRW V=0 Darboux component U_plus, does the mixed generator W define the canonical phase and positive principal half-density of a local momentum-polarization semiclassical FIO, and does the resulting one-term Van Vleck kernel satisfy exact finite-hbar coarea unitarity?

repository_sources.role: the immediately prior valid result fixing W, D, the U_plus domain, the canonical chart and every fail-closed quantum boundary
the reviewed classical derivation and action-ledger separation
the identity-kernel, lapse-modulus and full-line delta(C) distinctions that must not be conflated with an endpoint polarization transform
the fixed-endpoint polarization, ghost boundary and absolute-measure limitations that remain outside this bosonic FIO

primary_sources.source: Henneaux, Teitelboim and Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, Nucl. Phys. B 387 (1992) 391, arXiv:hep-th/9205092
primary_sources.used_for: the requirement that endpoint canonical data, boundary terms and endpoint state representations be transformed consistently
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving the repository-specific W, its FIO amplitude, exact unitarity, or a complete BFV source

primary_sources.source: García, Vergara and Urrutia, BRST-BFV quantization and Schwinger's action principle, Phys. Rev. D 53 (1996) 1368, arXiv:hep-th/9511092
primary_sources.used_for: the boundary that a BFV endpoint construction also needs multiplier, ghost, antighost, BRST-charge and gauge-fermion data
primary_sources.not_used_for: promoting a bosonic principal FIO to a BFV amplitude

primary_sources.source: Marolf, Path integrals and instantons in quantum gravity: Minisuperspace models, Phys. Rev. D 53 (1996) 6979, arXiv:gr-qc/9602019
primary_sources.used_for: the full-real-lapse distributional delta(C) rigging-map comparison boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: identifying the c momentum representation with delta(C), or calling continuous-spectrum delta(C) a bounded Hilbert-space projector

primary_sources.source: Van Vleck, The Correspondence Principle in the Statistical Interpretation of Quantum Mechanics, PNAS 14 (1928) 178
primary_sources.not_used_for: an exact finite-hbar normalization theorem for a nonlinear canonical transform

primary_sources.source: Hörmander, Fourier integral operators. I, Acta Math. 127 (1971) 79
primary_sources.used_for: the local microlocal canonical-relation and principal-symbol interpretation
primary_sources.not_used_for: global unitarity, edge domains, a physical inner product, or the model-specific calculations below

model.momentum_polarization: old (P,p) to new (c,p), with p transported by delta(p-p_prime)
model.compact_support: all microlocal statements are cut off in a compact K strictly inside U_plus and its chart image

exact_plan.canonical_phase: S_c=-T and S_P=Q, so i*h*d_c and integration by parts against i*h*d_P recover T and Q at principal order
exact_plan.local_maslov: W_cP=1/D>0 on U_plus, so the declared compact interior has no mixed-projection caustic or local sign jump
exact_plan.endpoint_phase: Psi=c*T+p*(Phi-phi)-P*Q-W has critical equations T=W_c, Q=-W_P, Phi-phi=W_p and Psi_crit=-B
exact_plan.shell_generator: at c=0 use the explicit W0=-P*log(R/(72*pi^4))/2+P-sqrt(3/2)*p*atanh(sqrt(2/3)*P/p) and recover W0_P=-Q0 and W0_p=Phi-phi
exact_plan.coarea_condition: in U_h^* U_h at P_plus and P_minus, exact one-term delta normalization requires M_geom=sqrt(M(P_plus)*M(P_minus)) to equal M_sec=(T(P_plus)-T(P_minus))/(P_plus-P_minus), where M=W_cP
exact_plan.shell_nonpass: at c=0, M is a positive constant times (3*p^2-2*P^2)^(-1/4); for P_plus=x and P_minus=-x it is strictly increasing on 0<x<sqrt(3/2)*p, hence M_geom=M(x)>x^(-1)*integral_0^x M(u)du=M_sec
exact_plan.local_defect: for deltaP=P_plus-P_minus about P_bar=0, M_geom/M_sec=1+deltaP^2/(6*A0^2*D0^2)+O(deltaP^4), reducing at c=0 to 1+deltaP^2/(36*p^2)+O(deltaP^4)

independent_methods: direct arbitrary-precision quadrature of the shell secant mean
closed hypergeometric antiderivative for the same mean

decision_table.condition: all principal-phase, half-density, shell-recovery, coarea-nonpass and numerical checks pass
decision_table.meaning: Keep the local compact-interior principal semiclassical FIO and fixed local Maslov branch; reject exact finite-hbar unitarity of this uncorrected one-term Van Vleck kernel only.

decision_table.condition: a canonical-phase, principal-half-density or shell-recovery check fails
decision_table.meaning: Reject the proposed momentum-polarization principal kernel while preserving the prior classical chart.

decision_table.condition: the principal construction passes but the exact coarea nonpass is not established
decision_table.meaning: Keep only the principal FIO and leave exact normalization of the one-term kernel unresolved.

decision_table.condition: the symbolic principal and coarea checks pass but the independent numerical control fails
decision_table.meaning: Record the symbolic calculation without promoting it until the frozen numerical control is reconciled.

computed_scope: the old-(P,p) to new-(c,p) momentum-polarization phase on compact interiors of U_plus
the positive principal half-density D^(-1/2) and fixed local Maslov branch
the explicit c=0 generator and its recovery of Q0 and Phi_star
an exact coarea discriminator for the uncorrected one-term kernel
independent high-precision shell quadrature and hypergeometric controls
not_computed: an exact or globally normalized quantum endpoint-state transform, full symbol, ordering, self-adjoint domain, spectral measure or edge boundary condition
a fixed-(Q,phi) to fixed-(T,Phi) coordinate-polarization kernel
ghost, antighost, multiplier endpoints, nilpotent BRST charge, gauge fermion or replacement BFV source
the old fixed-(a,phi) kernel equivalence, zero-lapse extension or full-real-lapse distributional delta(C) rigging map
other components, a global atlas, global Maslov or determinant-line orientation, Gribov census, physical original cycle, physics claim or TOE
